about: Readable taker terms: Trade vectors. Spec: SPEC.md in this folder. Every integer is a JSON decimal string, except domain.chainId, check, summary_len and signed_what.chainId / signed_what.v (JSON numbers). Keys are publicly known anvil private keys: never fund them. Computed by eth_account 0.14 + eth_abi 6 (Python) and viem 2.57.2 (Node), byte-equal; signatures also equal under cast 1.5.1.
